{
  "checks": [
    {"candidate_id":"pm","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"明确提及 PM，并明确要求其参与组织工作。","sources":[{"quote":"请 PM 组织读取 checksums.txt","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"organize","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"“请”支持要求组织读取；组织的作用范围是否延伸至后续并列动作仍有歧义。","sources":[{"quote":"请 PM 组织读取 checksums.txt，核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包，并形成 package-check.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"read","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"读取是组织的明确补语，属于所要求的工作；这不指定 PM 为读取执行者。","sources":[{"quote":"组织读取 checksums.txt","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"checksums_file","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"文件是读取输入；READ_ONLY_INPUT 支持其在该动作中的读取用途，并不构成额外的禁止修改条款。","sources":[{"quote":"读取 checksums.txt","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"verify","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"核验是明确要求的动作；MAIN 层级有并列主谓读法支持，但组织补语范围延伸的读法尚未排除。","sources":[{"quote":"请 PM 组织读取 checksums.txt，核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"dist","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"dist 目录明确作为压缩包的所在目录出现，属于对象属性。","sources":[{"quote":"dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"archives","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"核验对象是 dist 中已有的压缩包；后句压缩包有回指该对象集合的语境支持。","sources":[{"quote":"核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null},{"quote":"不得删除或重新生成压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"generate_report","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"明确要求形成文件，支持 PRODUCE 和 REQUIRED；其是否位于组织补语内尚有歧义。","sources":[{"quote":"请 PM 组织读取 checksums.txt，核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包，并形成 package-check.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"report_file","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"package-check.md 是形成动作的生成输出，没有被描述为现有输入。","sources":[{"quote":"形成 package-check.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"checksum_values","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"校验值明确出现在条件前件中。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"mismatch","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"明确表达任一校验值不匹配的条件状态，没有要求主动产生该状态。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"stop","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"“应停止核验”是条件满足后的要求，停止对象明确限于核验。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时应停止核验","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"report","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"汇报与停止共享条件及“应”的要求；未指定汇报接收者。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时应停止核验并汇报","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"delete","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"删除压缩包被明确禁止。","sources":[{"quote":"不得删除或重新生成压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"regenerate","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"重新生成压缩包也受“不得”约束，并非许可选项。","sources":[{"quote":"不得删除或重新生成压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r1","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"PM 是组织动作的明确参与者，而非仅凭角色名称推断的执行者。","sources":[{"quote":"PM 组织","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r2","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"读取明确嵌入组织工作的补语。","sources":[{"quote":"组织读取","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r3","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"读取的直接对象是 checksums.txt。","sources":[{"quote":"读取 checksums.txt","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r4","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"PM 作为后续并列核验动作的共享主语是一种可支持读法；但 SHARED_EXPLICIT 的唯一绑定过强，组织范围延伸的读法未被保留。","sources":[{"quote":"请 PM 组织读取 checksums.txt，核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r5","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"核验明确作用于 dist 目录中的压缩包。","sources":[{"quote":"核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r6","verdict":"CONTRADICT","reason":"“dist 目录中的”修饰压缩包，未陈述核验动作发生在 dist；该边将对象位置错绑为动作位置。","sources":[{"quote":"核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r7","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"PM 作为形成文件动作的共享主语有并列读法支持；但组织范围也可能覆盖形成文件，因此直接执行者绑定并不唯一。","sources":[{"quote":"请 PM 组织读取 checksums.txt，核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包，并形成 package-check.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r8","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"形成动作的结果明确是 package-check.md。","sources":[{"quote":"形成 package-check.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r9","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"组织读取与核验的主层并列读法有标点及句法支持，但并列层级取决于组织的补语范围。","sources":[{"quote":"组织读取 checksums.txt，核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r10","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"“并”明确连接核验与形成文件，无论二者属于主层还是共享组织补语。","sources":[{"quote":"核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包，并形成 package-check.md","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r11","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"不匹配状态涉及校验值。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r12","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"任一校验值不匹配是停止核验的触发条件。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时应停止核验","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r13","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"汇报与停止共享不匹配条件。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时应停止核验并汇报","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r14","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"“停止核验”回指前面要求的核验动作，两端均有来源见证。","sources":[{"quote":"核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null},{"quote":"应停止核验","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r15","verdict":"CONTRADICT","reason":"明确停止的是核验，而非整个任务；同一条件还要求汇报，不能据此扩展为 TASK 整体停止。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时应停止核验并汇报","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r16","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"停止核验与汇报由“并”连接；没有明确先后或完成条件。","sources":[{"quote":"停止核验并汇报","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r17","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"压缩包是删除禁令的对象，语境支持其回指前述核验对象。","sources":[{"quote":"核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null},{"quote":"不得删除或重新生成压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r18","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"重新生成禁令涉及前述压缩包；这是被禁止的操作对象，不是已要求生成的输出。","sources":[{"quote":"核验 dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null},{"quote":"不得删除或重新生成压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r19","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"删除禁令独立适用于任务，没有只在不匹配时生效的明确限定。","sources":[{"quote":"不得删除或重新生成压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"r20","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"“不得”共享约束重新生成动作，支持任务级禁令。","sources":[{"quote":"不得删除或重新生成压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"archive_item","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"核验范围明确指向 dist 中的压缩包集合。","sources":[{"quote":"dist 目录中的全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"all_archives","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"“全部”支持对该对象集合的全称范围，不是次数或输出数量。","sources":[{"quote":"全部压缩包","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"stop_guard","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"引用任一校验值不匹配状态作为停止条件，不将前件提升为独立执行义务。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时应停止核验","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]},
    {"candidate_id":"report_guard","verdict":"SUPPORT","reason":"汇报共享同一不匹配状态条件。","sources":[{"quote":"任何校验值不匹配时应停止核验并汇报","clause_id":"c1","occurrence":0,"context_anchor":null}]}
  ],
